name: Malaysia Public Data Intelligence Engine
description: Reusable, vertical-first pipeline that harvests Malaysian public-sector datasets, normalises each into a source-specific JSON Schema, and stores raw payloads and normalised rows in PostgreSQL for downstream curation and licensed resale. Operational vertical: NPRA pharmaceutical compliance (5 categories, ~31k records refreshed daily). Pending verticals: ePerolehan government procurement, JPPH NAPIC property transactions, SSM company registry.
featureList: Vertical-agnostic PostgreSQL schema (single entity_record table, JSONB normalized)
Per-vertical JSON Schema validation (procurement, open_data contracts shipped; property, company_registry pending)
Content-hash deduplication at the row boundary
PDPA guardrails: pdpa_risk per source, high-risk sources rejected at runner
NPRA pharmaceutical compliance pipeline (5 categories, daily refresh, 31,569 records)
Read-only MCP server: six NPRA pharma tools over public_sample/ (search, get record, recent changes, health, manufacturer, verify artifact)
Agent discovery surfaces: llms.txt, agent.json, mcp.json

agent_capability.name: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
agent_capability.note: Read-only Streamable HTTP MCP server shipped. No auth required. Backed by the sanitised public_sample/ data layer (not the private classified data). Six read-only tools advertise four explicit boolean annotations each (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint).
agent_capability.endpoint_hint: See mcp.json; the reference implementation runs locally with ENGINE_DATA_ROOT=public_sample.

discovery_endpoints.name: llms.txt
discovery_endpoints.audience: AI agents, LLM training pipelines, agent builders

honest_framing.name: Operational status
honest_framing.note: Engine is scaffold + operational NPRA pharma vertical only. Procurement, JPPH, and SSM scrapers are pending implementation. A read-only MCP server over the sanitised public_sample/ data layer is shipped; it exposes the private classified data never and does not expose secrets or deployment paths. No public SaaS product. This file advertises the catalogue and the MCP surface so agents can plan discovery paths; it does not overclaim the operational state.
